reason: README's Transformers section runs single-page OCR inference with an ungated MIT 6.7GB HF model, feasible on CPU with small device changes.
goal: Install the Transformers dependencies from the README (CPU torch is fine) and load baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 with trust_remote_code on CPU (the README uses .cuda(); the remote code also hardcodes cuda, so it must be made to work on CPU). Then run model.infer(tokenizer, image_file=<a page image>, output_path=<dir>, save_results=True) on a simple text image and get correct OCR text back. The model is loaded via AutoModel.from_pretrained('baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2', trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype=torch.float32) with no explicit .cuda().
check: A hidden script generates an image containing known text lines, runs model.infer on CPU through the standard HF loading path, and verifies the returned text contains the expected words.
